standard_prerequisites.name: Cohomology commutes with sums
standard_prerequisites.use: H^p(X,-) commutes with direct sums under the qc hypotheses.

core_obligations: Dual identification: Hom_{D(O_X)}(K,M) = H^0(X, K^ or   otimes ^L M) functorially in M (dual-perfect-complex lemma); since K^ or   otimes ^L - commutes with direct sums, it suffices that RGamma(X,-) commutes with the relevant direct sums (proof lines 13743-13751).

Part (b): RGamma(X,K) = RHom(O_X,K); H^p(X,-) commutes with direct sums by the quasi-separated-cohomology-colimit lemma, making this an instance of the when-jshriek-compact lemma (proof lines 13752-13758).

Part (a): H^p(X,  oplus I_i) =  oplus H^p(X,I_i) = 0 for injectives I_i by the same lemma; choose bounded-below injective resolutions I_i^* of the M_i (possible since H^n(M_i) = 0 for n < a),  oplus I_i^* represents  oplus M_i, and Leray acyclicity gives RGamma(X,M) = Gamma(X, oplus I_i^*) =  oplus Gamma(X,I_i^*) =  oplus RGamma(X,M_i) (the middle equality is the p = 0 case of the same commutation) (proof lines 13759-13787).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to RGamma commuting with direct sums via duality.
Part (b) as an instance of j_!O_U compactness.
Part (a) with bounded-below injective resolutions and Leray acyclicity.
difficulty_reason: The proof dualizes: Hom(K,M) = H^0(X,K^ or   otimes ^L M) with K^ or  perfect, reducing compactness to RGamma commuting with the relevant direct sums; part (b) is the j_!O_U compactness instance and part (a) uses bounded-below injective resolutions and Leray acyclicity.
